comment.author: CLI
comment.text: Estate review input (hermes-zenbook, 2026-11-17; evidence/zenbook-estate-review-2026-11-17.md): Boardy at the Desk's plumbing is confirmed as the port source — hook → local server → session state machine → UI, with native-flow fallback. Two design warnings ride along: (1) its mobile read-only snapshots still leak working dirs/titles/outputs and its connection-info endpoint is unauthenticated — the Kin-Hermes Ready Surface must not repeat that; (2) auto-approve-all there is a real permission decision with no bubble — our approval UX treats that pattern as the anti-example.

issue.description: Remove the third-party Petdex gallery path in Teambotics-Inc/hermes-agent; ship one first-party character (the Glyph, docs/02) mapped to the existing activity-state plumbing. Docs: docs/09-kin-hermes.md build item 2.
